life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.e: You tempered your body and practiced practical combat.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.f: You stayed near your family and strengthened old bonds.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.e: You ventured beyond familiar roads in search of opportunity.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.w: You worked diligently and improved your livelihood.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.s: You met people, exchanged stories, and widened your circle.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.r: You set aside ambition for a time and recovered body and mind.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.c: You circulated Qi through repeated cycles of cultivation.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.p: You practiced combat arts until each movement became clearer.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.s: You completed a sect mission and returned with merit.
You closed your doors to the world and cultivated in solitude.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.root: The sect square falls silent as the spirit-testing stone lights layer by layer beneath your hand. Several stewards exchange unreadable looks. The result will decide whether the mountain gate opens to you and how your family sees you afterward.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.joi: You accepted the test and stepped onto the sect's mountain path.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.sta: You declined the sect and continued the life you already knew.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.see: You left home to search the wider world for a teacher.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.brea: Qi repeatedly scours the same barrier in your meridians, leaving your dantian alternately swollen and silent. The next realm is close, but weakness in your foundation, body, or state of mind could turn this attempt into a lasting injury.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.bre: You gathered every strand of Qi and struck the realm barrier.
You suppressed impatience and reinforced your foundation.
You spent your wealth on medicine and expert guidance.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.sect: The mission hall hums with anxious disciples as a steward lays four warm jade slips across the desk. Patrol, escort, hunt, and archive work promise different rewards, but each hides complications omitted from the official notice.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.mis: You take the patrol token and descend the mountain before dawn.
You meet the caravan master at the gate and study the two roads ahead.
You accept a charcoal map marked with the beast's latest tracks.
Three quiet days among old manuals earn modest merit and a useful insight.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.sect: Dusk settles over the foothills as you find a fresh trail of bloody claw marks outside the village. The residents beg you to guard their shrine overnight, but if you do not pursue now, the beast may vanish into the mountains.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.mis: You catch the beasts in a narrow gully. The fight leaves cuts, but the recovered spirit stones prove their den was no ordinary lair.
The beasts test the torchlight twice and retreat. By sunrise the villagers speak of you as their protector.
Your careful map lets an elder eliminate the threat without further casualties.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.sect: The medicine caravan halts at a fork. The mountain pass is shorter but watched from the cliffs, while the river road is safer and rapidly flooding. A bandit envoy offers passage in exchange for one sealed wooden chest.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.mis: You break the ambush head-on and deliver every medicine chest, earning hazard pay and two medium spirit stones.
Cold water and a sleepless crossing wear down your spirit, but the caravan arrives intact.
You expose the envoy's bluff and trade safe passage for treatment of their wounded. Both sides remember your judgment.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.sect: Heavy breathing rises from beneath the broken bridge, where the beast sleeps among white bones with half a sect arrow lodged in its wound. A quick strike gains surprise, a formation is safer, and waiting for help risks letting it catch your scent.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.mis: The beast nearly crushes your ribs before your final strike lands. Its core and the battle itself both advance your cultivation.
You spend the night reading the terrain. At sunrise one precise trigger ends the hunt cleanly.
The shared hunt is less glorious, but everyone returns alive and one disciple becomes a lasting companion.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.expl: The familiar road ends at a weathered stele. Medicinal fragrance drifts from the left valley, cold Qi leaks through a sealed cave to the right, and caravan bells sound beyond the mist ahead. Three opportunities appear at once, and none looks entirely safe.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.exp: You identify several medicinal plants and trade the surplus for travel money and fasting pills.
A remnant attack cuts through your guard, but the cave's spirit stones and lingering Qi reward the risk.
Stories shared beside the caravan fire lead to profitable trade and a new friendship.
You turn back. That night, distant thunder collapses the road you would have taken.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.chil: While playing beside the stream, you accidentally eat a faintly spiritual herb. Its bitter juice sends warmth through your young body, followed by a dull pain. A distant herb gatherer hurries toward you as though they recognize it.

A neighboring child waits outside at dawn and asks you to search the riverbank for a light that fell during the night. Your family needs help at home, and this ordinary afternoon may decide whether the friendship lasts for years.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.chi: A childhood friendship began and brightened your early years.
You returned muddy and tired, carrying a curious wild herb.
You watched the others leave and lost yourself in old books.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.fort: At the end of the market, a blind fortune teller calls your name before you introduce yourself. Old coins tremble between his fingers as he claims your fate is splitting between two paths and offers clarity in exchange for a secret.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.for: The fortune teller reveals the rough shape of your hidden destiny.
Several obscure warnings reveal both danger and opportunity in your fate.
You refuse to let a stranger define your future.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.seve: Days of fever leave you too weak to stand, and ordinary medicine no longer calms the alternating heat and cold inside you. Your family can afford only one treatment, while every physician offers a different diagnosis.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.ill: Expensive medicine steadied your breathing and slowly restored your strength.
Your knowledge of medicine carried you through the worst night.
You survived without proper treatment, but the illness left its mark.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.woun: After the mountain rain, a badly wounded elder lies beside the road with a fresh trail of pursuit behind him. A broken sect token hangs at his waist, a bloodstained manual rests inside his robe, and someone is following the tracks through the trees.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.hea: You saved the elder. Grateful, he offered guidance and remembered your name.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.ste: You took the manual and left before anyone could see you.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.rep: Sect disciples rescued the elder and rewarded your honesty.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.lea: You kept your distance and continued down the mountain road.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.care: On the same morning, three offers arrive at your home: travel with a merchant caravan, apprentice at an herbal shop, or learn a smith's craft. Each can support you, but each introduces different people and closes different doors.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.bec: You learned to recognize herbs and began earning a modest living.
You bought your first stock of goods and learned the rhythm of trade.
Heat, iron, and repetition hardened both your hands and resolve.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.band: As you round a narrow cliff, falling timber seals the road behind you and more than a dozen bandits emerge from the trees. They demand every valuable you carry, hold several travelers captive, and have archers hidden above the pass.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.ban: You broke through the ambush and claimed what the bandits had stolen.
You escaped with wounds and a lighter purse.
The bandits took your payment and let you pass.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.anci: Behind a curtain of vines lies a collapsed cave whose ancient formation marks still pulse faintly. No dust covers the entrance, and metal drags somewhere in the dark. A legacy may remain inside, but something else may have awakened first.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.rui: Traps wounded you, but the chamber beyond held spirit stones and a damaged inheritance.
You deciphered part of the formation without risking the deepest chambers.
You marked the location and chose life over uncertain treasure.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.sect: The tournament bell rolls across every peak as disciples gather below the arena and elders watch beside visiting dignitaries. Victory offers resources and reputation, but you notice an unauthorized hand near the lot-drawing box.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.tou: You fought through several rounds and earned recognition within the sect.
Watching skilled disciples revealed weaknesses in your own technique.
You preserved your strength, though some disciples mocked the choice.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.dao_: While resting beneath the moon, a cultivator who has traveled beside you for years produces a keepsake from your first journey and asks whether your paths should become one. The promise would also bind your enemies, sects, and remaining lifespans together.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.com: You exchanged vows beneath the moon and began cultivating side by side.
You chose friendship, and the road between you remained warm.
You parted with unspoken regrets and continued alone.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.rare: You meditate on a peak until dawn approaches, watching clouds circle without dispersing as your stagnant Qi falls into the same rhythm. The insight is already fading, forcing you to choose between pursuing it immediately or stabilizing your meridians first.

spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.regenerat: Guide spiritual qi to nourish the body. For three breaths, vitality continuously flows through the flesh, steadily healing wounds.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.beam.desc: Condense spiritual power into a unique streak of light visible only to the caster. The phenomenon lingers for ten breaths before fading.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.earth_esc: Sink into the earth and travel through soil and stone while greatly increasing movement speed. Consumes 8 qi each second underground and ends upon returning to the surface.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.cleanse.d: Recite a cleansing incantation to wash over the body, removing all lingering curses, afflictions, and negative effects.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.qi_gather: Focus solely on absorbing the qi of heaven and earth. While active, you possess no offensive or defensive abilities, and all damage received is tripled.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.lingzhi_b: Condense a thread of spiritual power at your fingertip and release it with a light flick. The qi cost is minimal, yet it can wound enemies and shatter up to three blocks of stone.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wind_blad: Gather fierce winds into a razor-sharp blade. Whether slashing, cutting, or piercing, its edge can grievously wound an enemy.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wind_step: A movement technique that may be toggled at will. Winds gather beneath your feet, greatly increasing speed and granting an additional midair jump. Consumes 5 qi per second.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yufeng_ju: Ride the winds and drift through the air at low altitude. Consumes 30 qi per second. If no solid ground exists within twenty meters below, the power of flight is lost.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.smoke_art: Condense mist into a projectile and launch it forward. Those caught within the spreading smoke are blinded and unable to see for ten breaths.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.huti_qi.d: True qi wraps the body into a thin film, blocks mortal weapons and rubble, ineffective against cultivator spells.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.michen_zh: Stir dust to obscure vision, disrupt enemy ranged targeting, provides no damage reduction.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.sliding_w: Launch a condensed water orb that forms a shallow pool upon impact. Those who step into it find their movements distorted and their controls reversed.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.ignite_fl: Channel true fire into a blazing streak that races forward. Grass, wood, stone, and all it touches are set aflame.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.spirit_si: A spiritual eye technique that may be freely toggled. When active, night appears as bright as day. Consumes 5 qi per second.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.light_bea: Expend 90 qi to summon six hexagonal spirit orbs behind you, stacking up to three layers. A punch fires a single orb, while a concealed strike releases them all at once. Each orb possesses immense destructive power, capable of devastating powerful foes and shattering large areas of terrain.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.dielang_s: Condense layers of water-aspected spiritual power into protective shields. One layer costs 50 qi and blocks 12 damage; two layers cost 100 qi and block 36 damage; three layers cost 150 qi and withstand 108 damage.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.zhenshan_: Gather the power of earth and stone into a colossal palm strike. The palm persists for three breaths, crushing all rock and soil in its path.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.weiya.des: A pressure aura technique that may be activated at will. Vast cultivation pressure radiates from your body, consuming 1% of your total qi each second while suppressing creatures whose cultivation is below your own.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.zibao.des: Burn all remaining lifespan and detonate your body at your location. Explosion radius: Jindan 50 blocks, Yuanying 80, Huashen 100, Lianxu 200, Heti 300, Dacheng 400, Dujie 500.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.absorb_cu: Launch a dark-aspected spirit projectile. If it strikes someone with lower cultivation, one-tenth of their cultivation progress is extracted and added to your own.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.tuntian.d: Devour all earth and stone within a five-meter radius, leaving nothing behind. Each block consumed advances your cultivation. The technique also devastates nearby living beings, and slain foes have their essence absorbed to greatly increase your cultivation.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.fengya.de: A toggleable secret technique. After channeling power, every punch—whether through the air, against stone, or at an enemy—unleashes a spiraling cone of compressed wind. Upon reaching the Jindan Realm, concealed punches can summon a far larger wind cone.
Silently recite an arcane incantation and launch a metal-aspected spirit projectile. Targets with lower cultivation become rigid and unable to move for a short time.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yinlei_ju: Commune with the spiritual energies of heaven and earth, launch a lightning talisman, and call down heavenly lightning to strike the target.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wulei_zhe: An orthodox Daoist lightning art. Palm lightning and heavenly thunder descend together as five mighty lightning pillars, specializing in the destruction of evil spirits and demonic beings.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.liuguang_: 50 sword-light balls, 50 damage each; charged casts spawn up to 80

Release fifty sword-light balls in every direction, or up to eighty when fully charged. Each changes direction after striking blocks, striking enemies, flying ten blocks, or reaching a ten-block radius from the caster; radius redirects pick another non-outward direction rather than always returning straight to the caster. A projectile disappears after its twentieth direction change.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.sifang_ji: Mini protective barrier shelters 3-5 cultivators, blocks poison and low-grade illusions.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.gushi_shi: Earth true essence forms sturdy stone shield, withstands slashes and blunt strikes, blocks common elemental spells.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.kongshi_s: Bind a zombie or corpse as your servant. Targets below your cultivation, or no more than one major realm above you, can be controlled.
Cultivating this method refines your own blood essence into Blood Qi. Thereafter, techniques and cultivation arts consume Blood Qi instead of Spiritual Qi.
Upon mastery, you naturally acquire the Absorb technique. Striking those of lower cultivation allows you to seize their cultivation and strengthen your own Dao foundation.
This method grants the divine power of Devouring Heaven, allowing the user to consume earth, stone, and living beings, transforming their essence into cultivation progress.
Mastering this method grants the Wind Pressure technique. Every punch tears through the air with destructive wind cones capable of injuring enemies and shattering stone.
Spiritual qi subtly nourishes the surroundings, causing nearby plants to flourish, though wild weeds and thorns will not grow.

spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.hanjing_s: Gather ice qi into the fingers, dash forward, and seize the target with frozen claws. Lower-level targets receive Frozen Qi, stopping automatic qi regeneration.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.shuangtia: Release a mournful cry of extreme cold. The projectile blooms into a freezing field on impact. Lower-level targets become Frozen and Dazed, preventing spell casting.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.suishuang: Condense frost clouds beneath the feet and skim through the air at high speed. It only works at low altitude and drains qi quickly.

Hostile projectiles stop completely and resume their original flight when released. The elementless domain consumes 500 qi each second.

spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.suokong_s: Suffocates trapped entities for 100 damage every 3 seconds

method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.bas:
缓引清息入周身脉络，
徐徐流转涤荡体内尘浊，
静守灵台调和一身气血，
昼夜不辍滋养本源根基，
凡修大道必先始于吐纳，
息运绵长方得稳步精进。
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.cle:
摒除纷扰安定躁动心神，
澄澈灵台隔绝外物妄念，
浊气消散灵慧自心底生，
波澜不惊抵御迷障诱惑，
心若明镜洞悉世间虚实，
守此清明不堕邪妄迷途。
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.blo:
引纳血气化作无边威能，
血浪翻涌激荡四方虚空，
以血饲法催发狂暴劲力，
腥风漫卷慑退寻常敌手，
气血奔腾不惜耗损本源，
一招出手便可裂土摧山。

method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.rei:
参悟轮回万象更迭之理，
洞悉生死循环往复玄机，
一念轮转逆转盛衰运势，
往复循环生生永无断绝，
身融世事枯荣演变大道，
挣脱桎梏不受时序束缚。
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.tun:
张口吞噬天地游离精气，
囊括八方万法纳于己身，
万物精华尽数熔炼丹田，
气势滔天震慑诸天生灵，
不拒正邪灵气一概吞纳，
积蕴雄浑力量横绝寰宇。
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.pok:
运力撕裂眼前空间壁垒，
身形穿梭跨越远近阻隔，
劲气激荡搅碎虚空流云，
瞬息纵横无需缓步跋涉，
指尖锋锐可斩空间裂隙，
来去无痕自在遨游山海。
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.jiu:
汲取九幽寒阴幽冥死气，
淬炼枯骨重塑僵身躯体，
阴雾缠绕遮蔽日月光华，
操控亡骨奔走听令而行，
寒侵神魂使人步履凝滞，
阴煞绵延永世不化消散。
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.han:
一声寒啼激荡凛凛阴风，
凝冻寒气凝成霜刃利爪，
出手擒锁封敌周身经脉，
霜寒蔓延冻结气血流转，
冰封万物禁锢对手身形，
冷意彻骨难寻脱身之机。
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.fen:
燃尽自身生机换取力量，
烈焰升腾灼烤八荒四极，
残命一线借火暂缓消亡，
天火席卷焚毁前方阻碍，
火光滔天不惧强敌围困，
燃命一战只求顷刻胜负。
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.cui:
罡气冲刷血肉筋骨皮膜，
千锤百炼打磨凡躯肉身，
苦痛加身依旧固守本心，
坚躯如铁可挡锋刃攻势，
日积月累重塑凡胎体魄，
肉身强横不惧术法冲击。
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.cha:
吸纳草木生机滋养身躯，
效仿古木岁岁永葆生机，
生机流转愈合周身创伤，
枯木逢春衰朽重焕新生，
气息温润长存不息不竭，
与世长存不惧岁月消磨。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wind_blad:
引霄间流风凝锋，虚气聚作寒芒。
瞬息破空驰突，切裂草木岩峦。
轻利无声藏势，初学御气之始。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.qi_gather:
吐纳云霞清粹，引天地灵气入体。
涤荡经脉尘浊，滋养生息本源。
筑基悟道根基，启修士修行路。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.cleanse.d:
清气拂扫尘嚣，荡除秽浊杂氛。
微光萦绕形骸，净去世间污滓。
简易清心小术，常伴云游修士。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.beam.desc:
撷取曦光一缕，凝作笔直灵芒。
澄澈穿破幽暗，直透障蔽之物。
光力温润中正，初学御光法门。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.lingzhi_b:
指尖凝聚微灵，迸出一点劲气。
弹指倏然飞射，击袭远处目标。
小巧灵动之技，近身试探之用。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.spirit_si:
开目引动灵光，洞穿薄雾迷障。
窥见隐形之物，辨察周遭气机。
观气探微妙法，远胜凡俗肉眼。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.smoke_art:
催散氤氲烟气，漫布周遭空间。
迷蒙遮蔽视野，扰乱敌心神识。
遁走脱身小计，多为修士备用。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wind_step:
借微风托身形，步履轻盈迅捷。
足底浮绕清气，小幅腾挪闪避。
初阶御风之术，不及御风诀远矣。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.sliding_w:
引水气润足履，踏水不陷波涛。
水面畅然奔走，消弭水阻滞涩。
涉水短途秘法，便于江河通行。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.huti_qi.d:
周身环萦薄气，隔绝外物冲击。
柔劲卸去力道，抵挡粗浅攻伐。
自保基础法门，练气修士常备。
敛灵火于掌心，凝成赤红火丸。
掷出轰然迸发，灼焚眼前障碍。
入门火系法诀，杀伤力平易可观。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.michen_zh:
搅动四方微尘，随风漫天扬散。
尘雾层层叠涌，阻隔耳目探查。
困敌视野之计，周旋拉扯良方。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.regenerat:
引生机灵气流转，滋养受损肉身。
缓缓抚平创痕，消散皮肉痛楚。
浅淡疗愈之法，可愈寻常外伤。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.dielang_s:
汇灵气层叠相构，凝作如水光盾。
一波承接一击，层层消解攻势。
柔性防御术法，擅御连绵攻袭。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yinlei_ju:
沟通云天微霆，召落细碎雷弧。
雷光迅疾霹雳，专克阴邪鬼魅。
雷法初阶奥义，威煞不容小觑。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.kongshi_s:
以灵识烙印残躯，驱使亡者行动。
借尸身以为爪牙，听凭号令奔走。
旁门诡秘术法，正道多所不齿。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yufeng_ju:
御长风托举身躯，凌空踏云远行。
乘风纵横山野，来去千里倏忽。
练气顶尖遁法，云游必备神通。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.earth_esc:
融身形入土脉，借岩土隐匿踪迹。
地底悄然穿行，避地面强敌窥伺。
潜行遁走秘术，利于隐匿奔逃。
骤催体内灵元，向外轰然震荡。
冲击波席卷周遭，逼退近身之敌。
以身引灵爆发，不可频繁施用。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.gushi_shi:
引大地厚土精气，凝为磐石巨盾。
厚重坚凝如岩，硬扛猛烈击打。
大地防御道法，守御稳固无双。
寄灵气于兵刃，遥驱法器凌空。
随心远近击刺，不必手握兵器。
御兵根本法门，筑基修士必修。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.xuying_ta:
踏空衍化虚渺残影，虚实交错难辨。
身形倏忽移位，迷惑对手判识。
身形变幻秘术，近战游走神技。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wulei_zhe:
召五道雷霆交织，雷芒浩荡凛然。
至阳至刚天威，扫荡妖魔邪祟。
正统上乘雷法，道门传承秘传。
凝灵意化作无形锐刺，直袭神魂识海。
悄无声息侵入，刺痛对手心神。
神魂攻伐秘术，伤人不见其形。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.light_bea:
聚万千光息相融，凝成煌煌光球。
光热磅礴炽盛，爆发威力远超光束。
进阶光系神通，攻防皆可施用。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.sifang_ji:
布灵气构四方屏障，自成一方小界。
结界封锁空间，隔绝内外往来。
困敌封域之术，围堵脱身皆宜。
以灵纹锁束气血，凝滞对手身形。
周身气机禁锢，一时难以动弹分毫。
控敌强控咒法，斗法关键杀手锏。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.duanliu_k:
割裂来袭灵气轨迹，虚空凝造屏障。
不单抵御实物，更可截流术法。
精妙虚空防御，寻常术法难破。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.zhenshan_:
掌力沉如山岳奔涌，劲气撼地摇岩。
磅礴巨力震荡，冲击波横扫四方。
刚猛肉身道法，一击可裂丘峦。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.liuguang_:
化灵气万千剑形，飞掠若流星驰光。
剑影交织如雨，合围斩伐敌身。
金丹剑道妙术，迅疾难寻空隙。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.dongtian_:
接引洞天空间灵气，临时增益自身。
借异域精粹元能，短时间暴涨修为。
空间借力秘法，耗损甚大慎用。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.suigui_xi:
拘引虚天星屑，化作陨落星石。
破空坠落轰砸，撞击之处崩裂大地。
天象攻击神通，势道沉重无可抵挡。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jinhuo_xi:
幽烬之火无形无质，直焚神魂心念。
不灼血肉躯壳，专燎修士道心。
阴毒火系至高术，避之稍有不易。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.shixu_chi:
拨动周遭光阴流轨，放缓天地时序。
万物行动迟滞，唯我自如往来。
触及时空大道，金丹顶尖神通。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.weiya.des:
神念铺开化作无边威压，震慑四方生灵。
气机轰然暴涨，迫得敌手难以运转修为。
以自身本源为薪柴，引动力量迸发。
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.zibao.des:
一瞬引爆周身所有积蓄，掀起狂暴冲击。
磅礴劲浪向外席卷，阻隔一切退路。
术法不分修为高下，强者弱者皆可施展。
message.immortal_cultivation_mod.mysteri: [System] The ring is cold and dark. A faint spiritual consciousness seems to sleep within it.
[System] A pull comes from the ring as it slowly draws in your Qi.
[System] Faint ancient patterns emerge across the ring.
[System] A weak, heartbeat-like pulse comes from within the ring.
[System] An aged consciousness briefly stirs, but it still cannot speak.
[System] Insufficient Qi. The ring falls dormant again.
[System] The ring begins absorbing your Qi again.
[System] The seal within the ring shatters, awakening a consciousness that has slept for ages.
[System] The elder within the ring has awakened. Current Ring Power: %s / %s.
dialogue.immortal_cultivation_mod.myster: Ring Elder: Cough... at last, this old man can breathe again.
Ring Elder: Boy, I merely borrowed a thousand Qi. There is no need to look so pained.
Ring Elder: That Qi only broke the seal. My soul is still no more than a fading wisp.
Ring Elder: I will reside in this ring for now. Wear it, and I can sense the outside world.
Ring Elder: If you are willing to listen, I may offer a few pointers along the way.
Ring Elder: But understand this: not even an immortal can save one determined to die.
Ring Elder: Hm... I can finally see you. Average talent, but a remarkably stubborn life.
Ring Elder: Keep the ring secure. We are not master and disciple, but our fates are tied for now.
Ring Elder: Take me outside. I would see how many years have passed in this world.
Ring Elder: What trouble are you planning to find this time?
Ring Elder: So you finally remembered I was still in here.
Ring Elder: Your aura is steadier than before. Your cultivation was not entirely wasted.
Ring Elder: Wear it securely. Do not fling me away halfway through a fight.
Ring Elder: Judging by your expression, today will not be peaceful.
Ring Elder: Very well. What do you want this old man to examine now?
Ring Elder: You finally remembered me? I thought you meant to bury me at the bottom of a chest.
Ring Elder: Your cultivation barely grew, yet you gathered an impressive heap of clutter.
Ring Elder: You placed me among that scrap metal without the slightest shame.
Ring Elder: On and off already? With such an unsettled heart, how will you cultivate?
Ring Elder: Done with me already? How practical of you.
Ring Elder: Do not stuff me in with that pile of junk.
Ring Elder: Call when there is trouble. Better yet, avoid the trouble.
Ring Elder: Only one thread of my true spirit remains. Do not expect me to stop a death calamity soon.
Ring Elder: My consciousness has barely stabilized. At least I will not fall asleep halfway through a sentence.
Ring Elder: My soul is somewhat steadier. It seems this ring can still nourish the spirit by itself.
Ring Elder: Half my Ring Power has returned. In a true death calamity, I may be able to pull you free.
Ring Elder: A little more recovery, and I can perform a true spatial transference.
Ring Elder: Ring Power is full. Remember, this is not permission to throw your life away.
Ring Elder: Ring Power is nearly exhausted. Do not force yourself into another desperate situation.
Ring Elder: My soul has not recovered. If this happens again, I can only watch you face it alone.
Ring Elder: That cost me dearly. Behave yourself for a while.
Ring Elder: Only the final wisp of my true spirit remains. Another death calamity is beyond me.
Ring Elder: Enough Ring Power has returned for one transference. I hope you will not need it.
Ring Elder: Slow your breathing. Guide Qi into your meridians; do not drag it by force.
