life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.mist: Mist-Locked Qingxi Village: Qinghe leads you into a village trapped in one repeating day. The fox demon Feiyue and formation master He Xuan each claim the other created the dream array.
Expose He Xuan and shatter the array
Mist Disperses over Qingxi: the villagers awaken, Feiyue learns the truth, and Qinghe finally reaches tomorrow.
Aid Feiyue's revenge
Foxfire consumes the false dream and the village with it. Feiyue owes you a favor, while righteous cultivators condemn the act.
Trade the village for the Hundred-Thought Pearl
He Xuan seals every stolen emotion into the pearl and hands it to you. Its whispers sharpen thought while staining the heart.
Reverse the dream-mist array
One Dream Made True: He Xuan is trapped in his own cycle and Qinghe becomes the village's guardian spirit.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.star: Starfall Sinkhole: a lightless star opens a vast pit filled with inverted gravity, altered miners, and an unfinished host for powers from beyond this world.
Destroy the wreckage and seal the pit
The outer-sequence wreckage falls silent. Survivors return home, though several factions curse you for destroying an impossible opportunity.
Fuse with the unbound sequence core
The core accepts you, leaving foreign authority branded into your soul and a dangerous surge of insight behind it.
Let the cultivators research it together
The surviving factions establish a guarded research camp and remember you as the mediator who prevented bloodshed.
Reject every offered authority
Refuser of Selection: your refusal destabilizes the archive and reveals truths concealed from every willing host.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.bloo: Blood Moon Inn: every guest writes a name in the ledger, midnight repeats, and innkeeper Hongling needs one more soul to complete an old sacrifice.
Destroy the blood ledger
Dawn finally reaches the inn. The trapped guests scatter as the contract burns away.
Pay with part of your lifespan
You trade years of your own life for the captive soul. Both mother and daughter leave the inn before sunrise.
Help Hongling complete the rite
The blood feast ends and the inn recognizes you as an honored guest, but the other names vanish from its ledger forever.
Make every guest share the price
The eighth guest is revealed and the repeating night collapses without consuming another complete soul.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.name: Nameless Sword Tomb: countless ownerless blades surround a sword heart that tests whether inheritance, friendship, or one's own Dao matters most.
Accept the complete sword inheritance
You leave as the Nameless Sword Master, bearing a complete sword heart and the weight of every will within it.
Take only the sword intent
You refuse the binding sword heart and carry only its cleanest insight back into the living world.
Share the sword heart with Su Zhao
Twin blades reflect one another. You and Su Zhao divide the inheritance without dividing your paths.
Challenge the nameless sword spirit
My Sword Is My Name: you defeat the spirit without borrowing its identity and forge an independent sword will.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.drag: Dragonbone Wasteland: bone herders, a dragon-slaying guild, and the remnant dragon Ao Cang contest the marrow within an ancient skeleton.
Return the marrow and restore Ao Cang
Dragon veins stir beneath the wasteland. Ao Cang rises long enough to renew the land and remember your aid.
Sell the marrow to the guild
The guild makes you rich by carving the dragon remains into merchandise, leaving the wasteland spiritually barren.
Lead the bone herders to a new home
The tribe abandons the contested bones and survives. They preserve your name in their migration songs.
Release the dragon from life and death
Ao Cang neither revives nor perishes. Its will dissolves freely into the renewed dragon vein.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.reve: Reverse-Flow River: a faceless ferryman demands a cherished memory as fare while time-spirit fish carry lost years against the current.
Release the time-spirit fish
The river flows forward once more. Stolen memories return as quiet dreams to those waiting on its banks.
Exchange lifespan for the lost child
One life is traded for another. The mother finds her child while years vanish from your own future.
Steal memories from the river to cultivate
Foreign lifetimes flood your mind, bringing insight and power together with grief that was never yours.
Return each memory to its true regret
River of Regrets: you mend its course without erasing loss, and the ferryman finally remembers his own face.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.hund: Plague in Hundred-Herb Valley: a spreading illness, scarce medicine, and a merchant's concealed experiments force the valley toward judgment.
Treat the sick without distinction
Hundred Herbs Return to Spring: your treatment saves the valley and exposes the merchant who profited from its suffering.
Reserve the cure for those who can pay
The wealthy survive and your purse grows heavy, while the abandoned dead leave a stain no medicine can cleanse.
Burn the infected valley
Fire halts the plague together with countless lives and irreplaceable herbs.
Create a cure that renews the valley
A new medicine heals people, soil, and spirit plants alike. The valley is reborn around your formula.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.blac: Black Mountain Ghost Market: every bargain is paid with blood, lifespan, secrets, or a true name, and some contracts outlive their makers.
Redeem a stolen true name
A forgotten soul receives its name and identity again. The market grudgingly honors your lawful payment.
Sell your name for ghost-market wealth
You leave rich but nameless, and familiar faces struggle to hold you in memory.
Break the market's soul contracts
Ten thousand bound souls flee through the mountain as the market turns every enforcer against you.
Bind both owners of the same true name
One Name, Two Lives: you reconcile two histories the market insisted could not coexist.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.heav: Heavenly Secret Illusion City: the city offers the perfect life you never lived, while its tower stores countless unrealized destinies.
Wake and leave the perfect life
The Great Dream Ends: you accept the imperfect life that is truly yours and walk out with a steadier Dao heart.
Remain as lord of the illusion city
The city grants every desire and quietly closes its gates behind its new master.
Release every unrealized life
A million possible lives enter the world as dreams, inspirations, and dangerous deviations of fate.
Bring one illusion-born resident home
You give one unreal person a real future, proving that an origin in illusion need not make a life false.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.nort: Northern Snow Pass: the wall is failing, civilians crowd frozen streets, and the snow-beast king offers peace for the heart beneath the city.
Hold the pass for three days
Snow Pass Does Not Fall: the defenders survive three brutal nights and sing your name from the repaired walls.
Escort the civilians south
The city is lost, but its people cross the blizzard alive and begin again beyond the northern mountains.
Negotiate a pact with the snow-beast king
A difficult peace divides the frozen land without another massacre.
Let soldiers and civilians decide together
No Heroes in the City: no single legend claims the victory, because everyone shares its burden and authority.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.esco: Escort Elder Danxia: the elder carries a coveted pill formula while a poisoned village and pursuing enemies threaten the ordered route.
Obey the order and keep moving
You deliver Elder Danxia and the formula on time, earning merit despite the dangers left behind.
Stop to treat the poisoned village
The convoy arrives late, but an entire village survives because you refused to pass it by.
Expose the secret hidden in the pill chests
The pill case is brought to light, unsettling the sect while revealing why the convoy was attacked.
Publish the formula for common healers
All May Practice Alchemy: the formula spreads beyond sect walls and transforms mortal medicine.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.blac: Blackstone Mine Disappearances: miners vanish below, production collapses, and something beneath the ore remembers an older claim to the mountain.
Slay the mine spirit and restore production
The mine reopens after a brutal fight. Ore flows again, though the mountain's spiritual pulse grows faint.
Negotiate a ten-year mining pact
The miners and earth spirit accept strict limits, preserving both lives and a reduced flow of ore.
Reveal the sect's concealed mining crime
The truth costs several elders their positions and wins the surviving miners long-denied restitution.
Help the miners form their own sect
The workers establish a small earth-path sect that guards the mine instead of being consumed by it.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.reco: Recover the Defecting Disciple: Gu Changfeng fled with the Scarlet Yang Manual, but the sect's account of murder and theft contains dangerous gaps.
Execute the defector and recover the manual
You fulfill the enforcement order without hesitation and return with the bloodstained manual.
Help Gu Changfeng disappear
You return empty-handed while the defector begins a hidden life under another name.
Expose the purge behind the order
Evidence of an internal purge divides the sect and clears the names of several condemned disciples.
Bring the true witness before the sect
Her testimony forces an open trial and turns a secret execution into public reckoning.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.sect: Undercurrents at the Sect Tournament: a favored disciple's meridians are destroyed before the matches, and the culprit hides behind the sect's honor.
Reveal the sabotage and demand fair matches
The tournament resumes under scrutiny, and victory is decided openly on the arena floor.
Protect the sect's reputation
The scandal stays hidden and the tournament proceeds, preserving appearances at the cost of justice.
Choose a champion from the shadows
Your favored contender wins, but every informed disciple understands that the result was manufactured.
Suspend the title and reform the tournament
No One Takes the Crown: the sect accepts reform rather than naming a champion from a corrupted contest.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.lin_: Suppress the Lin Clan Rebellion: the sect demands overdue tribute, while evidence suggests the alleged rebellion conceals a larger enemy.
The clan city submits after heavy losses and the sect praises your uncompromising enforcement.
A revised compact restores peace and replaces impossible demands with duties the clan can actually meet.
The Lin Clan breaks from the sect and remembers who risked condemnation to defend its freedom.
Unite both sides against their common enemy
Hidden evidence exposes the outside hand that engineered the conflict, turning enemies into an uneasy alliance.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.guar: Guard the Herb Garden for Seven Days: a Nine-Revolution Spirit Ginseng nears maturity while thieves, beasts, and a desperate fox mother gather nearby.
Guard the ginseng without compromise
The ginseng matures untouched and the sect records a flawless seven-day watch.
Use part of the medicine to save the fox cub
The cub survives, and its mother leaves a quiet blessing among the garden paths.
Steal the mature spirit ginseng
You flee with the priceless medicine while the sect begins a relentless search for the thief.
Refine one ginseng into three shared pills
One Ginseng, Three Pills: precise refinement saves the cub, rewards the sect, and leaves a portion for your own path.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.seal: Seal the Ancient Demon Cave: whispers beneath the forbidden ground reveal that the imprisoned demon may be a severed part of the sect founder.
Repair the seal exactly as ordered
The ancient cave falls silent and the sect praises your obedience, leaving its oldest lie untouched.
Destroy the imprisoned evil thought
You cut away the founder's corrupt remnant, though its final memories scar your mind.
Release the demon from the cave
The broken seal frees a powerful enemy and grants you a share of forbidden knowledge.
Reunite the founder with the severed remnant
The Complete Founder: righteous and demonic memories become one, exposing the true origin of the sect.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.miss: Find the Missing Mountain Patrol: seven disciples are trapped in a repeating forest formation, but evidence suggests an eighth traveler entered with them.
Lead all seven disciples out together
Seven Return to the Mountain: you hold the group together and break free without abandoning anyone.
Save the nearest survivor before the array shifts
You carry one disciple out as the paths close behind you, leaving six fates unresolved.
Cut through the looping formation by force
Your assault tears open a way home, injuring several disciples but ending the cycle.
Find the identity of the eighth body
The Eighth Body: uncovering the infiltrator's death reveals who built the loop and why the patrol was selected.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.oute: Outer Disciples' Lost Souls: seventeen disciples lie unconscious while a concealed formation burns their dreams as fuel for the sect.
Return all seventeen souls
Seventeen Souls Return: every disciple awakens, and the hidden formation is dismantled.
Preserve one willing dream as the new guardian
One disciple remains asleep by choice, using a single endless dream to guard the sect without consuming others.
Replace the disciples with another source
The disciples awaken, but your substitute keeps the cruel mechanism alive under a different name.
Reveal the formation to every disciple
Ten Thousand Minds, One Thought: the sect rebuilds the array as a voluntary shared meditation instead of a secret sacrifice.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.thre: Three-Sect Covenant: assassination, a political marriage, and forged spell traces threaten to turn alliance talks into open war.
The Three-Sect Alliance forms against the true conspirators, with you recognized as its decisive mediator.
A Covenant Beneath the Sword: all three sects sign while secretly preparing for the day coercion fails.
Secure control of the alliance for your sect
Your sect takes the alliance's resources and authority, driving its partners into quiet resistance.
Three Sects, One Council: shared votes replace political marriage and create the cultivation world's first cross-sect institution.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.stor: Your decision draws the scattered clues into a clearer route. Your companions remember the position you took, while the questions left behind may surface again when the situation changes.

New evidence completes one corner of the truth and proves your earlier understanding incomplete. Some witnesses now trust you with more, while others realize the investigation is close and begin destroying traces or preparing a counterattack.

The truth can no longer remain hidden, and every faction moves before the final confrontation. Old allies demand that you honor earlier promises, while enemies turn neglected choices into traps that will shape the ending.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.mist: An unnatural fog folds the mountain road into a loop. The dead girl Qinghe begs you to enter Qingxi Village, whose people awaken into the same day every dawn.
Follow Qinghe
Inspect Array
Test Qinghe
The village repeats tiny accidents exactly. Names of living villagers appear on old graves, and at midnight every sleeper walks toward the ruined fox shrine.
Question Villagers
Follow Midnight
The fog is a vast dream array fed by a gray pearl. Its inscriptions reveal a second hand guiding the fox demon's grief and harvesting every emotion in the village.
Trace Caster
Steal Array Core
Qinghe admits she died eighteen years ago but remained awake to protect the villagers. Binding her may expose the array, while trusting her may preserve the only innocent witness.
Trust Qinghe
Bind Qinghe
At Fox Hill, He Xuan's deception is uncovered: he framed the villagers for killing Feiyue's cub and used her illusion to refine a Hundred-Thought Pearl.
Expose Hexuan
Bargain Hexuan
Reality and dream overlap as the array collapses. Qinghe, Feiyue, the villagers, He Xuan, and the pearl cannot all be saved; your earlier evidence determines which endings remain possible.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.star: A black star falls without flame and extinguishes the constellations above it. Sects, miners, black-robed strangers, and a youth hearing an alien voice gather around the new sinkhole.
Enter Openly
Sneak Inside
Follow Mad Youth
Gravity reverses in the first cavern. The trapped miners see futures, lose their shadows, or grow translucent limbs, and rescuing them will slow every later descent.
Rescue Miners
Study Mutation
A seamless metal wreck lies below the mine. Five lights within it carry killing, wealth, fortune, time, and mission authorities, while rival factions close in.
Hide Fragments
Warn Factions
The mad youth is becoming a vessel for something beyond the world. You may cut the link before it finishes, or accept a lesser mark to learn what is choosing hosts.
Free Host
Accept Mark
At the bottom, an unfinished host copies every technique and asks permission to overwrite your soul. Its unbound sequence core survives after the battle.
Stabilize Core
Claim Core
The sinkhole collapses while every faction demands the core. The survivors, evidence, and alien marks gathered along your route determine whether it is sealed, shared, sold, or mastered.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.bloo: A red-lantern inn appears in a storm. Proprietor Hongling asks for your name and warns you never to open the final ledger page before dawn.
Sign True Name
Use False Name
Inspect Inn
At midnight seven guests sit before corpse-scented dishes. One soul must remain so the others may leave, and every guest offers a reason to sacrifice someone else.
Defend Guest
Offer Criminal
The forbidden page records that the sacrifice never truly ends the night. Names repeat in different inks, including one written in your own future hand.
Read Last Page
Steal Ledger
The mute servant is Hongling's dead daughter, scattered by an old sacrifice. Restoring her may end the mother's search; binding her could instead control the inn.
Restore Daughter
Bind Daughter
The ledger opens and the walls reveal a mass grave. Hongling demands one complete soul before the last blood moon ends.
Break Sacrifice Rule
Complete Sacrifice
The inn tears apart between repeated nights. The truth, mercy, and ritual authority you gathered decide who leaves, who pays, and whether the cycle ever existed at all.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.name: Thousands of rusted swords hum in a nameless valley. Each stone records why its owner failed, while sword cultivator Su Zhao asks you to enter beside her.
Answer With Sword
Read Sword Marks
Follow Su Zhao
Three sword gates test greed for victory, fear of drawing, and pride in invincibility. Force can cut through them, but surrendering to the intent may reveal another path.
Cut Three Gates
Yield To Intent
Broken epitaphs show the tomb was built not for heroes, but for every cultivator erased from official sword histories.
Restore Epitaph
Take Sword Formula
Su Zhao admits her clan sent her to claim the inheritance alone. Trust may make her an ally; a duel will decide who reaches the deepest chamber first.
Trust Suzhao
Duel Suzhao
The sword spirit offers to inscribe your name across every blade. Accepting grants command; erasing the name frees the forgotten intents but leaves no owner.
Accept Sword Name
Erase Sword Name
Every sword rises for the last trial. Your route determines whether you inherit by force, share the intent, depart unnamed, or challenge the tomb itself.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.drag: A caravan collapses where colossal dragon bones surface from the desert. Bone merchants rush toward the remains while a buried cry shakes the remaining oasis.
Save Caravan
Follow Merchants
Trace Dragon Cry
The oasis settlers live atop the dragon's last heart vein. Defending their homes may wake it; evacuation abandons everything they built.
Defend Oasis
Evacuate Oasis
The merchants harvest bones that still carry memory. Selling them brings immediate wealth, while exposing the trade may turn every buyer against you.
Sell Dragonbone
Expose Merchants
A fragmented dragon soul remembers the wasteland as its living body. It asks for its memories back before the final vein is cut.
Restore Dragon Memory
Bind Dragon Soul
The skeleton begins to breathe sand. Restoring the dragon vein may remake the land; harvesting the awakening remains could enrich one generation and ruin the next.
Heal Dragon Vein
Harvest Remains
The wasteland rises with the dragon's final breath. The settlers, merchants, and soul all claim a different future for the same land.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.reve: A river runs uphill carrying boats, memories, and years toward its source. A ferryman, a grieving woman, and whispering water each offer a different entrance.
Board Boat
Follow Woman
Study Water
The ferryman accepts no coin, only one memory. Refusing means crossing a current that strips names from the living.
Pay With Memory
Refuse Fare
The woman's child drowned years ago, yet the river shows him aging backward upstream. Telling her the truth may break her; following may change the death.
Seek Child
Reveal Child Death
Each eddy holds a regret discarded by a traveler. Returning them heals old lives; keeping them grants insight bought with strangers' pain.
Return Memories
Keep Memories
At the source, a spirit fish swims through possible histories. Freeing it restores natural time; seizing it lets one regret be rewritten.
Free Spirit Fish
Seize Spirit Fish
The river begins flowing both ways. Only the people and truths you preserved can anchor a chosen history before the banks disappear.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.hund: A medicine valley blooms while nearby villages rot from an unknown plague. The sick, the rare herbs, and the poisoned soil each point toward a different culprit.
Treat Sick
Search Herbs
Inspect Soil
The poorest patients were used as unpaid trials for a sect medicine. Free treatment earns testimony; selling doses funds faster research at their expense.
Free Medicine
Sell Medicine
The only useful herb grows faster when fed infected blood. Careful harvest preserves the valley, while stripping it bare guarantees enough medicine now.
Harvest Sparingly
Strip Valley
Buried contracts reveal the plague was designed to raise medicine prices and test a forbidden cure. Publishing them will implicate several respected healers.
Expose Source
Hide Source
A complete cure exists, but it has never survived a living meridian. You may test it on yourself or burn every infected field before it spreads.
Test On Self
Burn Infected Field
The plague reaches its peak as merchants seal the valley exits. Your medicine, evidence, and treatment choices decide whether the valley is cured, sold, burned, or renewed.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.blac: Paper money leads to a night market where names, memories, and future years are traded. One stall displays an item labeled with your own name.
Follow Paper Money
Trace Stolen Name
Enter Future Stall
A broker offers your true name back for a treasured memory. Without it, contracts may claim your achievements as belonging to someone else.
Buy Name Back
Sell Memory
Thousands of stolen names hang as lantern tags. Freeing them restores forgotten lives; taking the ledger grants authority over every contract in the market.
Free Stolen Names
Claim Name Ledger
A future version of you offers victory in exchange for one present relationship. Refusal preserves your life; agreement makes two incompatible histories real.
Reject Future
Trade With Future
The market owner admits every stall is bound by the first stolen name. Tear the contracts to free the dead, or seize the seal and inherit their debts.
Tear Contracts
Take Market Seal
Dawn approaches and unpaid names begin fading. The market can return your life, sell it, release every contract, or reconcile two versions of the same person.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.heav: A city offers the perfect life you never lived. Its observatory stores countless unborn destinies, each waiting for a real person to surrender a path.
Enter City
Mark Exit
Speak Unborn
Family, sect, wealth, and love are arranged exactly as you once wished. Accepting makes the dream denser; rejecting reveals cracks behind familiar faces.
Accept Ideal Life
Reject Ideal Life
The city array consumes abandoned possibilities to keep its walls real. A marked exit can guide you home, while cutting it may strand every resident.
Trace City Array
Cut Exit Path
The unborn residents know they are possibilities, not illusions. They ask for one chance to enter reality even if someone else's future must narrow.
Promise Real World
Deny Unborn
At the seventh bell, the city must either open permanently or fold all lives back into one dream. Every promise you made becomes binding.
Open City Gate
Seal City Dream
The perfect city begins choosing which version of you is real. Your marked exit, promises, and resistance determine who crosses the final gate.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.nort: Snow beasts surround a failing frontier pass while civilians fill its streets. Missing scouts carry evidence that the war began with a human breach of an old pact.
Enter Pass
Scout Beasts
Find Scouts
The walls can survive only with labor taken from evacuation. Repairing them strengthens defense; preparing escape preserves civilians if the pass falls.
Repair Walls
Prepare Evacuation
The snow-beast king demands return of the stolen heart core beneath the city. Negotiation risks the walls; ambush may end the talks forever.
Parley Beast King
Ambush Beast King
The scouts prove a border officer falsified the first attack to seize the heart core. Revealing it may split the defenders in the final night.
Reveal Officer Lie
Hide Officer Lie
The final beast tide gathers. You can lead a desperate defense or open the gate under truce banners before either side loses control.
Lead Defense
Open Negotiation
Snow buries the battlefield as soldiers, civilians, and beasts demand a settlement. Earlier preparations decide whether survival requires victory, retreat, pact, or shared rule.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.esco: Nine sealed pill chests knock from within as you escort Elder Danxia to an allied sect. The captain demands obedience, but one voice inside calls a fellow disciple by name.
Guard Carriage
Aid Poisoned Village
Inspect Elder Cargo
Masked cultivators strike only at the chest chains and shout that the captives are living pill subjects. One attacker claims his sister is still conscious inside.
Hold Formation
Capture Attacker
Leaking spirit poison leaves an entire village unconscious. Danxia orders an immediate departure, although opening one chest may provide both an antidote and proof of the experiment.
Share Antidote
Question Villagers
Inside the chests are people whose meridians have been rewritten into medicinal vessels. The formula could expose the crime, or be copied and transformed into a safer art.
Copy Pill Formula
Confront Elder
Danxia admits everything and offers discipleship for your silence. The allied reception party arrives already prepared to receive the living subjects.
Complete Delivery
Publicize Formula
The convoy reaches the final pass. Your prisoners, antidote, copied formula, and public testimony decide whether the living pills are delivered, freed, exposed, or replaced by humane alchemy.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.blac: Blackstone Mine has lost dozens of workers, yet its overseer demands production resume. Altered ledgers, songs below the seventh layer, and angry families offer three paths into the case.
Audit Ledgers
Descend Seventh Layer
Organize Miners
The books prove that the overseer secretly mined a forbidden core vein and divided the profit with sect elders. Silence money is offered before you can copy the final page.
Copy Ledger
Accept Silence Money
The walls breathe around living miners sealed safely in stone. The mine is the crystallized blood of an ancient earth spirit that asks for its stolen heart crystal.
Hear Earth Spirit
Mine Earth Heart
The workers learn that they were sacrificed to protect illegal profits. Some demand weapons and revolt; others want an audited agreement that keeps their families alive.
Arm Miners
Mediate Strike
Guards enter as the earth heart wakes and the tunnels begin closing. You can seal the seventh layer immediately or bring every witness and record to the surface.
Seal Seventh Layer
Bring Truth Up

Mine guards, workers, elders, and the earth spirit confront one another above a collapsing shaft. Earlier alliances determine whether the spirit dies, a pact is signed, corruption is exposed, or the mine becomes worker-run.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.reco: The sect orders Gu Changfeng recovered dead or alive for stealing the Scarlet Sun Art. His supposed victims are merely sealed, and three trails suggest the official account is false.
Chase Directly
Visit Hometown
Shadow Other Hunters
You corner Gu Changfeng, but he refuses lethal force and asks for one chance to explain why the stolen jade slip contains names rather than cultivation formulas.
Wound Defector
Hear Defector
Letters from his missing sister describe disciples burned by a lifespan-consuming experiment. Protecting the family preserves witnesses; seizing the letters fulfills the hunt order.
Protect Family
Seize Letters
The second pursuit team destroys evidence and carries a secret execution order for every surviving subject. You may expose them or join the purge before Gu reaches the cave.
Expose Kill Order
Join Kill Order
In the cave, Gu's sister is alive but her meridians are burned away. The jade slip records every experiment, and the sect force is moments from breaking in.
Take Testimony
Carry Out Order

The cave siege forces a final declaration. Your evidence, treatment, and loyalties determine whether Gu is executed, escapes, exposes the Scarlet Sun purge, or returns with his sister as a living witness.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.sect: Before the sect tournament, a favored disciple's meridians rupture from poison he never knowingly drank. Entering the bracket, examining the wound, or following a gambler exposes different conspirators.
Enter Tournament
Inspect Wound
Follow Gambler
Your own bracket has been fixed. A steward offers resources if you throw one match and carry a weak disciple into the final.
Fight Fair
Accept Fixed Match
The poison was meant to remove a disciple preparing to expose elder corruption. Saving the next target may reveal the assassin; chasing the assassin leaves the victim vulnerable.
Save Target
Trace Assassin
The betting ring includes merchants, stewards, and elders. Its ledger can blackmail them for years or collapse the entire tournament if exposed now.
Take Blackmail
Expose Betting Ring
One finalist carries an exploding artifact, the other a fatal enhancement pill, and an assassin waits outside for the witness. The bought referee calls them to the arena.
Fight Final
Stop Final
The arena waits for your evidence or your blade. The route you chose decides whether the tournament is purified, its reputation protected, its champion manipulated, or every finalist walks away.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.lin_: The sect orders the Lin clan suppressed for hiding a spirit mine. Refugees instead describe impossible tribute, missing children, and a tax envoy whose official death record does not match his corpse.
The enforcement elder orders an immediate assault before civilians evacuate. A final parley risks being called treason but may expose who profits from the mine.
The young heir accepts transparent tribute, while radical elders seek demonic aid for independence. Supporting either side will decide who controls the ancestral hall.
The envoy was killed by his own escort after discovering forged tribute accounts. A demonic mark on the weapon points to someone deliberately provoking both factions.
The sect prepares a surprise attack as Lin radicals begin sacrificing civilians to summon an ancestor spirit. One accusation could unite both sides against their manipulator.

The ancestral hall burns between two armies. Your evidence and alliances decide whether the clan is crushed, tribute is reformed, independence is won, or both sides turn upon the hidden demonic instigator.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.guar: You must guard a Nine-Turn Ginseng for seven days. On the first night an injured spirit fox steals medicine, an array rune is cut from inside, and the ginseng whispers that it fears harvest.
Heal Fox
Inspect Sabotage
Guard Ginseng
The fox's powerful mother arrives, not for the ginseng but for her wounded cub. Returning it may earn an ally; using it as bait buys a chance to ambush every beast at once.
Reunite Foxes
Use Fox As Bait
A guard admits the elder plans to keep the ginseng and blame every defender for its loss. He offers to steal it with you before the fifth-day beast tide.
Arrest Traitor
Join Theft
The ginseng has awakened and asks for one more year to transform. Harvesting now fulfills the order; protecting it means deceiving the sect through the final day.
Promise One Year
Harvest Now
On the seventh day, elders, beasts, the traitor, and the ginseng all act at once. A beast tide also turns toward the nearby village and wounded guards.
Protect People
Protect Ginseng

Dawn reveals what survived seven days. Your promises and preparations decide whether the sect receives a perfect harvest, the foxes take the medicine, the ginseng is stolen, or alchemy preserves it while producing three pills.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.seal: Whispers seep from a forbidden cave said to hold an ancient demon. Repairing the seal, answering the voice, or reading forbidden founder records reveals a different version of sect history.
Repair Seal
Answer Whisper
Read Founder Records
Four sealing nails replay the founder's rise, massacres, fear, and final division. One nail is false and hides the memory the sect most wants erased.
Replace Four Nails
Remove False Nail
The prisoner calls itself Xuanzu, the founder's discarded crimes and desires rather than an outside invader. It offers forbidden experience in exchange for release.
Accept Demon Offer
Test Demon Memory
Hidden records prove the founder's good remnant and evil half share one soul. Destroying either may cripple the sect's inheritance and mountain array.
Reveal Founder Split
Hide Founder Split
The elders arrive with an order to seal everything and reward your silence. The two halves of the founder reach for one another through the failing formation.
Join Two Halves
Destroy Evil Half

The cave opens before the whole sect. Your preserved memories determine whether the old seal remains, the evil half is cut away, Xuanzu is released, or the complete founder returns to confess and reform the sect.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.miss: A seven-person patrol's final message says they found their own corpses for the third time. In a forest trapped at dusk, a signal, a survivor, and a repeated body point in conflicting directions.
Follow Signal
Search Survivors
Inspect Repeated Body
The signal repeats from a clearing that resets whenever approached. Rushing in reaches one timeline quickly; circling it reveals the formation is learning your route.
Rush To Signal
Circle Signal
A wounded disciple accuses the captain, while the living captain calls him an enemy spy. Carrying him preserves a life; prolonged questioning may reveal which memories were planted.
Carry Survivor
Question Survivor
Seven corpses show seven failed branches, but an eighth wears your equipment and carries a letter in your handwriting. Burning them erases clues but weakens the loop.
Count Eighth Body
Burn Bodies
The array is a sect trial never meant to release its subjects. One real spy knows the shutdown sequence, while the array eye begins collapsing every timeline together.
Extract Patrol
Destroy Array

All versions of the patrol converge at sunset. The people and future message you preserved decide whether seven return, one is chosen, the array is shattered, or the eighth corpse guides everyone out unharmed.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.oute: Seventeen outer disciples sleepwalk toward the rear mountain while losing memories each day. Their bodies, shared dream, and the mountain-guarding array reveal different parts of the extraction.
Wake Disciple
Enter Shared Dream
Inspect Guard Array
The bodies are healthy but their souls are being thinned to fuel the array. Preserving every body keeps return possible; using one as an anchor makes the dream easier to enter at a cost.
Preserve Bodies
Use One As Anchor
In the shared dream, the sect falls repeatedly and the disciples sacrifice themselves to repair it. Leading them home weakens defense; remaining behind can hold the dream open.
Lead Souls Home
Remain Dream Guard
The elders admit a hidden failsafe consumes low-ranked souls whenever spirit stones run short. Public disclosure risks revolt; redirecting it merely chooses different victims.
Publish Array Truth
Redirect Array
An enemy probe strikes the weakened barrier as the seventeen souls near dissolution. There is time either to return them all or restore the array at full strength.
Return Seventeen Souls
Keep Array Power

The dream and mountain barrier demand a final source of power. Your route determines whether the disciples awaken, one remains as dream guardian, condemned enemies become fuel, or everyone voluntarily shares a harmless fragment of thought.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.thre: Three sects gather against a demonic expansion, but each demands command, mines, or protection. Public talks, secret conditions, and a marriage envoy lead into different political webs.
Every public concession shifts military power. A balanced charter is fragile; favoring your own sect promises rank and resources but breeds resistance.
Private promises prove all three delegates intend to exploit the alliance. Publishing them forces honesty; using them lets you trade one faction against another.
A core disciple is offered as political collateral against their will. Freeing them weakens the old pact; enforcing it buys immediate stability with a person's life.
A forged spell kills a representative on signing night. Evidence points to a fourth demonic faction, but one sect is ready to profit if its rival dies.

Armed delegations face one another in the final hall. Your alliances decide whether the plot is revealed, an alliance is forced, one sect dominates, or a joint council replaces marriage and private rule.
The imperial genealogy jumps from the eighth prince to the tenth. A sealed palace, erased records, and a severed dragon vein each preserve a different trace of the missing ninth heir.
Old servants still prepare nine ceremonial robes, and a lower-city youth named Ji Wuming bears a royal dragon mark. Protecting him gains his trust; using him attracts ambitious princes.
The Ninth Prince was erased rather than killed after an oracle tied his name to dynastic collapse. Restoring the name exposes the emperor; erasing the last copy buries the heir forever.
The dragon vein refuses all successors while its ninth branch lives. Freeing it ends exclusive royal control; feeding it Ji Wuming's life stabilizes the old order.

At the coronation eclipse, rival princes, the Astronomical Bureau, rebels, and Ji Wuming all converge beneath the manifested dragon. You must let the rite proceed or break its law before a successor is chosen.

The dragon circles the capital awaiting a name. Your evidence and treatment of Ji Wuming determine whether he rules, is sacrificed, becomes your puppet, escapes unnamed, or returns the dragon vein to the people.
Ji Wuming takes the throne and reforms the empire from memories of the lower city. The capital prospers, while noble factions mark you as an enemy.
Ji Wuming is sacrificed beneath the palace. The dragon vein and crown prince's reign stabilize, purchased with a life the empire erased twice.
You place Ji Wuming on the throne and govern through him. Wealth and influence surge as every prince and noble begins planning your death.
The last evidence burns and Ji Wuming escapes the capital. He enters the wider world free, uncertain whether to thank you or resent the stolen crown.
Return the Dragon Vein to All
The dragon vein is divided among the provinces. Royal divine right ends, common spiritual awakenings increase, and a council replaces the imperial capital's old rule.
Yunhai Market begins falling toward a mortal city with twelve hours remaining. The formation district, trapped lower wards, and black market each hold one part of the missing power core's truth.
Engineers reveal the lift array was powered by a living heart. Restoring the old channels will raise the city quickly; redirecting them can distribute the burden among temporary cores.
Thousands below have no escape ships while merchant clans evacuate treasure. Saving every district costs precious hours; cutting the lower ward loose preserves the floating city.
The stolen core is the divided heart of Yun Kun, an ancient cloud beast imprisoned for centuries. Returning it frees the creature; binding it gives one faction complete control.
The market's shadow covers the mortal city. You can force it upward with the remaining core or steer it toward empty land while residents complete evacuation.

The final hour belongs to merchants, workers, Yun Kun, or whoever controls the core. Earlier rescues and array work determine whether the city rises, lands, travels freely, becomes yours, or saves everyone without another prison.
Yun Kun is suppressed and its heart powers the formation again. Yunhai Market rises, rewarding you while the ancient beast's hatred deepens.
Yun Kun is freed and the population survives a controlled landing. The market becomes a permanent ground city governed increasingly by workers.
The inhabitants rebuild upon Yun Kun's back by consent. The living city now crosses the world and visits only trusted merchants.
You seize the core and become owner of the floating market. Its income is immense, as is the coalition of guilds preparing to overthrow you.
Temporary cores hold the city, the vulnerable evacuate, and Yun Kun is freed. Merchants, workers, and beast form a new alliance without sacrifice.
Residents without reflections vanish after seven days. Beneath the full-moon lake lies a reversed copy of Jingyue City, and three investigations lead to incompatible histories.
Your alternate self remembers every path you refused. Recognizing the mirror residents protects their identity; claiming their city treats them as replacement lives.
The surface council demands the lake gate sealed before more doubles arrive. Evacuating civilians preserves lives but allows both histories to overlap.
A Moon Mirror split one city during an ancient disaster: one suffered and one escaped. Restoring both preserves truth but creates duplicates; choosing one erases every life formed in the other.
The Moon Mirror can no longer hold the division. You may merge every counterpart into one city or shatter the artifact and accept whatever fragments survive.

Two moons overlap above two populations. The identities and records you protected decide which city remains, whether reflection replaces reality, whether both coexist, or whether two independent histories are stabilized.
The mirror city is destroyed and the missing return. Jingyue stabilizes, but every alternate self vanishes beneath the final moon.
The mirror city replaces the surface. Familiar people remain with different memories, loyalties, and histories.
Both cities merge without erasing duplicates. Jingyue becomes powerful and unstable as every family confronts another possible life.
The Moon Mirror breaks and districts from both cities sink. Survivors build among flooded ruins where reality still changes with moonlight.
Space and illusion arts separate the histories into paired cities. Each can visit the other without consuming it, and your alternate self becomes an ally.
An invitation summons you to become the Gu Mother's twentieth-year bride. Former brides, the ancient mother, and divided swamp tribes each offer a different account of the covenant.
The former brides are alive as vessels linked through one body. Freeing them breaks generations of memory; taking the bridal mark lets you command the network from within.
The Gu Mother protects the swamp from an older plague but sustains herself through one human vessel every twenty years. Killing or inheriting her transfers different costs to the tribes.
The original pact required every tribe to share protection and sacrifice, but powerful clans shifted all payment onto outsiders. Renewing it shares responsibility; breaking it risks plague.
On the wedding night, the Gu Mother opens every vessel and the tribes prepare to burn the nest. You can protect the chosen bride or hold the wider swamp together.

The bridal veil falls as every stored voice speaks. Your pact and treatment of the vessels decide whether the cycle continues, the mother dies, a bride escapes, you inherit the body, or all tribes forge a shared covenant.
The covenant continues through you. The swamp remains safe, while your identity slowly joins the voices of earlier brides.
The Gu Mother dies and every vessel opens. The tribes gain freedom but must face the ancient plague without their old guardian.
You free the chosen bride and flee the swamp. She becomes a companion, while hunters and the weakening covenant follow both of you.
You inherit the Gu Mother's network and authority. The swamp obeys, but thousands of instincts now contend with your own will.
Every tribe contributes a harmless portion of Qi to contain the plague. No bride is sacrificed, and the swamp becomes a confederation.
The furnace city is failing as its heavenly fire weakens. Broken furnaces, a chained fire child, and the grand artificer's plan reveal three ways to preserve the domain.
The city concentrated all fire into one central furnace, starving ordinary workshops. Sharing it restores thousands of hearths; feeding the center preserves mass production.
The fire child is the mountain's newborn spirit, bound before it learned speech. Returning it renews the land; binding it permanently guarantees industrial flame.
The grand artificer wants to forge one city-scale artifact from the last Heavenly Heart. Helping saves the city's military power; seizing it grants a personal treasure.
The last furnace can ignite only once. You may pour all remaining fire into it or divide the flame before the old industrial order consumes it.

The Heavenly Heart cracks over the city. Your choices determine whether the furnace burns eternally, the spirit returns to nature, one great artifact protects all, you claim the heart, or ten thousand independent hearths awaken.
The child is rebound and the central furnace burns without pause. Tianlu retains unmatched production at the cost of another spirit's freedom.
The child returns to the volcano and the heavenly fire becomes wild again. Mass production ends, while the land slowly heals.
Forge One Artifact for the City
The last fire becomes a city-protecting artifact. Every workshop dims, but Tianlu survives future calamities behind one mighty treasure.
You seize the Heavenly Heart and leave with a peerless treasure. Tianlu fractures into factions that will never stop hunting you.
The last flame is divided safely among ordinary workshops. No single furnace rules Tianlu again, and a guild republic rises from the ashes.
A thirteenth island appears only during the black tide and holds travelers lost across a thousand years. A disputed map, stranded ships, and a coral clock offer three approaches.
People from incompatible centuries have built a fragile camp. Anchoring the island preserves them in the present; looting its temporal relics may strand everyone again.
Each ship belongs to a different disappearance. Guiding all of them costs the entire tide window; saving one guarantees survivors but abandons the rest to time.
The tide clock can return one era only by erasing another. Reversing its mechanism seeks a fair solution; borrowing it grants decades of cultivation by stealing future travelers.
The black tide recedes and the island sinks. You can hold it above the water to create a settlement or open a return current before the clock disappears.

The clock strikes across a thousand years. The groups and records you preserved decide who returns today, whether the island is anchored, whether its time is exploited, whether it sinks, or whether every ship reaches its exact home.
The most recently lost return home, including the cartographer's daughter. Ancient travelers fade as the island chooses the present.
The island remains in the present and every era's survivors build one society. A permanent thirteenth island appears on the map.
You gain decades within the tide while one outside year passes. Each future use will pull another unknown traveler from their journey.
The clock is destroyed and the island sinks forever. Its people are scattered into unknown moments of history.
The repaired clock returns every traveler to the instant after disappearance. No history is erased, and the daughter comes home bearing centuries of memory.
Every classroom has seven desks but only six names. The empty seat, a student writing from book margins, and the academy's fate register each preserve part of a deleted life.
The empty seat remembers Pei Zhao, erased because his future threatened the academy. Restoring it causes forgotten relationships to reappear; leaving it empty preserves the current class.
Pei Zhao survives between printed lines and remembers the original timeline. Pulling him out endangers students created by his absence; using his fate can enrich your own future.
The fate register creates famous graduates by redirecting opportunity and tragedy between students. Burning pages ends prediction; writing a new one makes you the next editor.
The headmaster turns to Pei Zhao's page as current students begin losing achievements. You can restore the deleted student or preserve the history that grew from his absence.

Ink spreads across every student record. Your handling of the seat, Pei Zhao, and the register decides whether he returns, remains erased, the book burns, you control fate, or a separate history is created for him.
Pei Zhao returns and exposes the academy. The original timeline rewrites several current achievements and relationships.
Pei Zhao remains in the margins so the current students survive unchanged. The academy grants you access to the fate register.
All engineered futures end. The academy loses its perfect graduates, but no student's success will require another student's ruin.
You steal the register and gain limited power to alter future events. Every change transfers misfortune to someone unknown.
Create a Person Outside the Books
Pei Zhao returns through a separate stable history. With no recorded past, he remembers altered timelines and travels as your companion.
Pilgrims surrender painful desires and leave calm but incomplete. Guiding them, entering the desire vault, or approaching the hidden seventh statue reveals where those emotions went.
Some pilgrims lost love, survival instinct, or identity along with pain. Returning desires restores difficult lives; erasing the last fragments grants perfect calm.
Centuries of stored emotions collide in the vault. Releasing them sends each voice searching for its owner; taking them grants insight at the risk of many personalities.
The seventh statue speaks in thousands of voices and rejects desireless enlightenment. Questioning it reveals each origin; becoming its vessel gives those voices a living body.
The abbot begins merging with the statue, hoping to create a perfect enlightened being. You can stop the rite or complete it before conflicting desires tear the temple apart.

The statue opens its countless faces. Your treatment of desire determines whether an emotionless Buddha rises, desires return, all enter your heart, the temple loses them forever, or it learns to understand rather than amputate them.
The abbot becomes powerful and nearly emotionless. Peace fills the temple as every resident slowly loses individuality.
Each stored desire returns to its owner. Pain and love return together, bringing temporary chaos and eventual honesty.
Take All Desires Into Your Heart
You absorb the statue and gain immense mental insight. Future choices may be influenced by the thousands now living inside you.
The statue and all stored emotion are destroyed. The immediate danger ends, while thousands remain permanently incomplete.
The statue becomes a mirror that reveals feelings without taking them. Wuxiang Temple becomes a center for healing heart demons.
At Jiuyou Ferry, the death ledger lists your name one year early. A living passenger, an unnamed ghost, and stolen lifespan records pull the investigation in three directions.
The ledger insists your death is valid because someone paid to insert it. Writing your own name accepts fate and grants underworld favor; erasing it challenges the entire accounting law.
Shen Nian is alive, but her remaining years were sold to a wealthy cultivator. Returning her requires equivalent lifespan; surrendering her keeps the ferry schedule intact.
A merchant's vault contains years stolen from poor mortals. Returning them changes many scheduled deaths; keeping them grants wealth and longevity stained by every victim.
The ferry bell rings and every listed soul is compelled aboard. Turning it back risks underworld law; taking the ferryman's oar transfers his duty and authority to you.

The black river opens toward deeper death. The names and lifespan you preserved decide whether Shen Nian returns, the ledger wins, stolen years are restored, you command the ferry, or every fraudulent death date is rewritten.
You pay with your own lifespan and return Shen Nian to life. She remembers Jiuyou and remains bound to your future.
Obey the Name in the Ledger
Shen Nian boards according to the ledger. The ferryman grants underworld access, while her family begins searching for the truth.
Seize Stolen Years and Return Life
The lifespan merchant falls and every stolen year returns to its owner. Unexpected survivors reshape many futures, and your false death is removed.
You take the oar and authority over soul passage. The dead obey, but every future crossing becomes your responsibility.
Every falsified entry is corrected without harming legitimate fate. Safe routes between living cities and Jiuyou Ferry permanently open.
Every western traveler returns through Duanjie's eastern gate. The looping road, duplicate expedition records, and a wall that breathes reveal different pieces of the world's edge.
The road loops because it is one chain in a spatial prison. Sealing it preserves the lock; opening it connects two copies of the city and weakens the boundary.
Two cities share every resident, and harm crosses between counterparts. Merging expeditions preserves both memories; destroying duplicates powers the prison through erased lives.
Duanjie is a lock around the World Devourer. Repairing it closes other realms forever; speaking with the prisoner offers passage in exchange for fragments of isolated worlds.
Both cities begin merging as the walls inhale. You can anchor the prison in place or release the city from its role before the being wakes fully.

The edge opens onto a sky without this world's stars. Your treatment of duplicates and the lock decides whether Duanjie guards forever, opens a realm gate, sacrifices one city, contracts the Devourer, or becomes a moving inter-realm fortress.
The prison is reinforced and the World Devourer sleeps. Duanjie remains trapped, safe from what lies beyond.
You open the boundary and defeat the escaping Devourer. A second world map and paths to higher realms become available.
Trade One City for the World
One duplicate city is consumed to power the gate. The surviving city gains freedom and remembers every vanished counterpart.
Make a Pact With the World Devourer

life.immortal_cultivation_mod.map.travel: A collapsed mountain road blocks the caravan. A wounded cultivator blames a beast, while the caravan leader calls him a bandit scout.
Help the wounded cultivator
You treat the stranger and gain a grateful guide, though the delay costs strength.
Search the surrounding slopes
Tracks reveal a hidden cache and the true path around the collapse.
Continue without stopping
The caravan leaves the dispute behind and reaches the route safely.
Seize the cultivator's storage bag
You take the bag and leave him behind; wealth rises together with local suspicion.
Bandits surround the road and demand payment after displaying captured travelers.
Break through by force
You defeat the ambush and recover part of the stolen cargo.
Pay the demanded toll
The bandits accept payment and let the journey pass unharmed.
Abandon the road and flee
You escape through rough ground, shaken but alive.
Negotiate for the captives
Careful words split the bandits and open a route without a full battle.
A spirit storm twists Qi, weather, and direction across the route.
Shelter until it passes
The safe delay carries the journey into the next annual segment.
Force a path through
You cross through injury and gain hard-won combat experience.
Study the storm's circulation
The pattern wounds your focus but yields rare comprehension.
Harvest concentrated Qi
You seize dense Qi at personal risk and continue with greater cultivation.
A broken seal reveals forbidden cargo hidden within the caravan.
Report the cargo
Authorities reward your report and seize the shipment.
Ignore it
The cargo remains hidden and the journey continues quietly.
Join the transaction
You earn a share of the illicit profit at a moral cost.
Confiscate it yourself
You take the cargo by force, gaining valuables and local enemies.
A great flying beast shadows the route and dives toward the travelers.
Repel the beast
You drive it away after a costly aerial fight.
Evade through cloud cover
The journey escapes, though the chase strains everyone's nerves.
Attempt to tame it
You endure its attacks and form a bond with a new spirit mount.
Follow it off route
It leads you toward rumors of the hidden Guixu Islands.
A teleportation array tears open at the wrong coordinates as its spatial anchors fail.
Stabilize the formation
You repair the anchor and arrive with new spatial insight.
Endure the distortion
The passage injures you but still reaches its destination.
Abort the teleport
The array closes safely, delaying the journey.
Observe the broken coordinates
You study the failure and gather cultivation insight before landing.
